title: Dynamic-programming best packet basis
scope: Cached bottom-up evaluator equals the global selector; stop on ties. One comparison per internal node; at most 3*node-count unit operations for visits/comparisons/value additions with node costs supplied. Not a Lean runtime or scalar-cost evaluation bound.

title: Cyclic product law
scope: Formal power-series cyclic product and literal q-tuple power formula over commutative semirings, including q=0. Analytic interpretations apply on their convergence domains; no arbitrary divergent evaluation is asserted.

title: Polyphase Möbius action
scope: Explicit exponential root of unity and modulo-N action on the projective quotient of nonzero homogeneous pairs; Cayley conjugacy and the finite-chart formula.

title: Impedance–admittance is the two-phase split
scope: The N=2 phase is -1; its action swaps homogeneous coordinates, exchanging zero/infinity and giving inverse impedance on the nonzero chart.
